# Catalogue 653: Powhatan Ellis to John Forsyth, No. 9, Legation of the United States, Mexico, 16 Nov 1839.
# NARA RG 59, Despatches from US Ministers to Mexico vol. 9, microfilm M97 roll 10 (naId 189102194). Code on frames
# 0298 (after the heading "No. 9 ... Sir,"), 0299, 0302 and 0303 (before the clear closing); the Department's clear
# copy (words only) is on frames 0300-0301, filmed between the code leaves. Frame URL pattern:
# https://catalog.archives.gov/medialz/dc-metro/rg-059/603720/M97/M97-010/M97-010-0298.jpg
# Read from crops of the frames; every line checked a second time, independently, on full-frame views and about
# 15 lines on enlarged crops (0298.07-10, 0299.11, 0299.21-22, 0302.07, 0302.24-26, 0303.02-03, 0303.09,
# 0303.14-17): no disagreement.
# The first column is the line: frame and line number. One token per code group, as written.
# Marks: [ins: ...] = groups written above the line with a caret; + = mark under the group (in 0302.24 the mark
#        under 1111 may be a small circle); o = superscript o after the group (-s); ? after a group = uncertain reading.
# Uncertain: 0298.06 657 (perhaps 651), 0299.02 1263 (perhaps 1261), 0303.03 last group 560 or 500 (the clear copy has
#        "enemy"; both stay open), 0303.02 833 (first digit under an ink blot), 0303.09 731 (middle digit 3 or 2).
